findings.claim: Mandatory task-scoped TDD proof was not supplied.
findings.observed: The run manifest declares tddRequired=true, the caller explicitly supplies no TDD proof, and the follow-up checkpoint states that the proof helper rejected RED because the implementation already passed and therefore did not publish a task-scoped RED/GREEN artifact. The referenced Test Gate is green but contains only the registered backoffice test/build command, not the required TDD provenance.
findings.rationale: The task contract explicitly requires reuse or linkage of genuine historical RED evidence plus fresh GREEN verification under this follow-up task. A passing Test Gate and agent-reported test counts do not replace the required durable RED/GREEN proof artifact.
findings.required: Provide valid task-scoped TDD provenance that links the genuine parent RED and records the follow-up GREEN according to the required proof contract, without fabricating a new RED.
